key.name: reading-style
key.description: One of the bundled style ids. An unrecognised value falls back to the default rather than stopping the app, so a downgrade is survivable.

key.name: appearance
key.summary: Light, dark, or whatever the desktop is set to

key.name: view-mode
key.summary: How much Markdown syntax is shown
key.description: Opening a document shows it rendered. Live mode reveals the syntax of whatever construct the cursor is in, which is what you want while writing and not what you want on the first screen of a document you opened to read.

key.name: show-outline
key.summary: Whether the heading outline is shown

key.name: window-maximized
key.summary: Whether the window was maximised when it was last closed
